description:
Simple word/phrase search (case- and accent-insensitive), max 20 results. To keep it fast it searches ONE book if `book` is given (e.g. ROM); otherwise ONLY the four Gospels (MAT MRK LUK JHN) and the Psalms (PSA).
ES: Búsqueda simple; sin `book` busca solo en Evangelios y Salmos.

bible.description: Bible id (e.g. drc, kjv, torresamat, rv1909; see about or /api/bibles). Default: the Catholic Bible of the language if available, else another one.

book.description: Optional book id to search in (e.g. GEN, ROM, SIR)

query.description: Word or phrase / Palabra o frase

name: bible_search
title: Bible search
